text: Case: Customer reported unauthorized $2,500 transfer to new payee added same day. Investigation found device fingerprint mismatch. Resolution: Reversed, account locked.
Case: Multiple small transactions under $50 within 10 minutes to different merchants, flagged as card testing pattern. Resolution: Card frozen pending verification.
Case: Customer attempted a $9,400 transfer after an unrecognized device login. Resolution: Transfer reversed and device trust reset.
Case: Password reset was used to add a new payout recipient and submit a $7,150 request. Resolution: Request cancelled and account re-secured.
Case: Customer used wallet services in two countries within hours and triggered a manual hold on a $5,800 transfer. Investigation pending for identity verification.
Case: New browser session, unknown IP, and a pending payout request of $6,900 were flagged before authorization. Case remains open for verification.
